admission.justification: The public command and planner compute instruction replacements before the declared-copy projection is published, so contributors must not publish package bytes from an earlier measurement plan or renew only the canonical carrier.

applicability: Instruction fact and declared-copy planning through the public renewal command.
conditions: The command reads canonical instruction sources and authored declarations.
exclusions: Publication is a sequence of file writes with attempted restoration; no whole-filesystem atomicity or guaranteed rollback is promised.
statement: One instruction renewal entry point computes current instruction facts and declared package copies before publishing changed files.
